title: May 2026 Documentation Audit
description: Reconcile Kestrel Sovereign documentation after package extraction, context/memory/storage/LLM/signal/Talon work, and archive stale documentation scaffolding.

stories.title: Reconcile feature and package truth sources
stories.description: Fix source-of-truth drift across KESTREL_FEATURES.md, feature_registry.toml, pyproject.toml, generated feature docs, and package-boundary language.
stories.done: Core vs feature package vs provider package vs standalone tool boundaries are explicit, generated feature docs are regenerated from corrected inputs, and registry semantics are documented.

stories.title: Update main documentation entry points
stories.description: Update README.md, docs/README.md, and docs/architecture/README.md to point to canonical sources and avoid duplicating unstable details.
stories.done: Main entry points describe current package boundaries, link to canonical docs, and do not contradict corrected feature inventory.

stories.title: Reconcile volatile architecture docs
stories.description: Re-audit context, memory/retrieval/storage, LLM routing, signals/workflows, and Talon docs against current code and package ownership.
stories.done: Each volatile system has one canonical doc or explicitly marked design/history docs, with stale claims updated or archived.

stories.title: Reconcile user, operator, demo, and generated docs
stories.description: Update user-facing docs, deployment docs, demo scripts, generated docs, and launch copy for optional-package and current-behavior accuracy.
stories.done: User/operator docs distinguish base install from optional packages and match current CLI/UI behavior.

stories.title: Clean diagrams, archive scaffolding, and public-release hygiene
stories.description: Add status/date/owner notes to diagrams, archive or mark superseded old audit/index/review scaffolding, and classify internal/public doc directories.
stories.done: Old scaffolding no longer competes with current docs, diagrams carry status, and public-release-sensitive directories are classified.
